item.title: CVE-2026-123373 · compose-lint: A committed symlink makes compose-lint quote a file from outside the project into its output
item.description: ### Impact Like Docker Compose, compose-lint follows symlinks when it reads a project's files. item.title: CVE-2026-119191 · Forge: ASN.1 resource exhaustion via BIT STRING decoding in asn1.fromDer
item.description: ### Summary `asn1.fromDer()` decodes the contents of BIT STRINGs as ASN.1 by default. Fixed in node-forge 1.4.1. ### Detai | Producto: node-forge | Corrección: 1.4.1

item.title: CVE-2026-115779 · Effect: Cookie attribute injection via domain, path, and name fields in @effect/platform makeCookie()
